component_guidelines.navigation_bar: Sticky fixed navbar with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-50. Include LGU Seal badge, search input, Role switcher (Public / LGU Admin / Reviewer / Auditor), and Stellar Network indicator dot.
component_guidelines.philippine_currency_formatting: Always format money values with Philippine Peso symbol ₱ and comma separation e.g. ₱50,000,000.00

component_guidelines.audit_trail: Append-only tabular timeline with actor role, timestamp, action name, document checksum hash, and direct link to Stellar Horizon Testnet explorer transaction.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive elements, buttons, tabs, inputs, state badges, and hash displays using kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='verify-project-button', data-testid='lgu-selector-dropdown', data-testid='verification-status-badge')

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the UI feels like a modern official Philippine civic transparency platform (like COA / DPWH open portal elevated with high tech design).
Avoid generic AI slop: no dark neon gradients, no generic centered cards, no unformatted JSON dumps.

Make the verification flow at /verify/:projectId/:packageId extremely vivid and unambiguous: big status banner, SHA-256 side-by-side comparison, original hash vs computed hash, and Stellar transaction anchor link.
Include mock data with authentic Philippine LGUs (e.g., LGU Pasig City, LGU Naga City, LGU Iloilo City, LGU Davao City, LGU Bohol).
All monetary figures must use Philippine Peso format (₱50,000,000.00).
Every button, search input, filter, modal trigger, tab, and card must carry explicit data-testid attributes.
